authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13952 haḍḍa gives Punjabi haḍḍī, western hāḍ and the addendum’s hāṛko/hāḍkī/hāḍgu bone forms. This supports Gojri aḍḍi with initial h-loss and Nimadi hāḍkā; it does not equate unexplained final clusters or suffixes automatically. Joint comparison: Noiri haḍka “bone” matches reviewed Nimadi hāḍkā “bone” (f_sahsjfgljzsmk). The shared family is provisionally linked under the user’s preference; inheritance versus intra-IA borrowing is not resolved by this formal comparison.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 12548 śuṣka explicitly gives Palula šuko and Western Pahari śukkha/śūkho, with an -ll- extension in Torwali šugil and Oriya sukhilā “dry”. The survey simple and l-extended dry forms fit the documented family; the article retains the extension under this head. Joint comparison: Noiri sukhal “dry” matches reviewed Dang sukʰʌl “dry” (f_zh5zvzf52t536). The shared family is provisionally linked under the user’s preference; inheritance versus intra-IA borrowing is not resolved by this formal comparison.
